study type: Mixed method study (cross-sectional survey and qualitative interviews)
outcome: self-reported ability to perform Essential Obstetric Care (EOC)
satisfaction with training scheduling and content
cohort: The study included 240 maternal health workers and managers who provide maternal health services, and 43 health workers and managers for in-depth interviews, from 5 health districts across two provinces in rural Vietnam.
finding: In-service training programs for maternal health workers in rural Vietnam were perceived by participants as irrelevant to their needs and poorly planned, which may contribute to a perceived inability to provide Essential Obstetric Care.
